note: Soldier small-kit mass capture: radio, medical, tool, hydration, food, power and misc. All masses are published values from manufacturer datasheets, manufacturer product pages, or military documents downloaded and sha256-hashed here. Tier 5 pages are recorded in leads only. Where a source publishes both lb and kg the kg figure is used; where only lb is published the exact conversion 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg is applied.
